name: app-6ab1d988e2a88191bcae826e72d99caf
description: Search, inspect, and download CC0 sound effects from Lots of Sounds.

interface.longDescription: Lots of Sounds is owned and operated by Elliott Labs Ltd. Browse free CC0 sample sounds without an account. Connect an account to search the full catalog, inspect sound metadata, and get time-limited download links.
defaultPrompt: Find a rain sound and get a download link for the best match.

positive.prompt: Show me six free sample sounds.
positive.expected_behavior: Return six curated free samples with each sound name, duration, description, and CC0 licence metadata.

positive.prompt: Find a notification chime shorter than two seconds.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for a chime with a two-second maximum and return matching catalog entries, including each sound's duration and CC0 licence metadata.

positive.prompt: Find five ambient rain sounds from Lots of Sounds.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for rain in the Ambient category and return no more than five matching Lots of Sounds catalog entries.

positive.prompt: Show the full details for sound ID fs-237729.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the sound's catalog metadata, including its title, description, duration, category, CC0 licence, and tags.

positive.prompt: Get a download link for sound ID fs-244053.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a signed download link with its expiry information. Do not expose a permanent storage credential.

negative.description: Do not call a tool. Explain that the plugin finds existing sounds and cannot generate audio or speech.
negative.prompt: Generate a new voice recording that says hello.

negative.description: Do not call a tool. Explain that the plugin cannot upload files or add sounds to a user library.
negative.prompt: Upload this audio file to my sound library.

negative.description: Do not call a tool. Explain that the plugin cannot delete catalog sounds.
negative.prompt: Delete every rain sound from the catalog.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not process payments. Free sample browsing needs no account. Full catalog search and download links require a Pro or Enterprise subscription that users manage on the Lots of Sounds website.

publication.release_notes: Identifies Elliott Labs Ltd as the verified business that owns and operates Lots of Sounds. Restores the reviewed mixed public and OAuth connection settings.
